summary.text: Chris Rothfuss is a Democratic member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 9, in office since 2011, and has been Senate minority leader since 2013; he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a chemical engineer by training.

paragraphs.text: Chris Rothfuss obtained a B.A. in international studies and an M.S. in chemical engineering from the University of Wyoming, and an M.S. in applied physics and a Ph.D. in chemical engineering from the University of Washington.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a chemical engineer and consultant.
Rothfuss was first elected to the Senate in 2010 and has served as minority leader since 2013.

For 2025-2026 he co-chaired the Select Committee on Blockchain, Financial Technology, and Digital Innovation Technology and was assigned to the Senate Education Committee, the Senate Rules and Procedure Committee and the Senate Minerals, Business and Economic Development Committee, among others.
